init.title: Where to send reports
init.description: Both are optional: leave a field empty to not use it. Telegram messages go through Home Assistant's Telegram bot integration: set that up first and add the chat to it, then pick the chat here. The Telegram and Print receipt switches turn each one on or off.

data_description.telegram_chat: A chat of the Telegram bot integration. Only shown once that integration has a chat.
data_description.printer_address: 80 mm ESC/POS network printer, as host or host:port (port 9100 if left out)
data_description.printer_font: Only if the receipt text looks wrong; the default is DejaVu Sans if found

error.invalid_printer_address: Use host, host:port or [IPv6]:port, with a port from 1 to 65535, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:9100.

send_homework_report.name: Send homework report
send_homework_report.description: Sends what's due on the next school day and the rest of the coming week. Returns the report's text when asked for a response.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Smartschool account.

date.name: Today
date.description: Pretend today is this date. Leave empty for today.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Send to Telegram. Leave empty to follow the Telegram switch.

print.name: Print
print.description: Print the receipt. Leave empty to follow the Print receipt switch.

send_results_report.name: Send results report
send_results_report.description: Sends the results published since the last results report (at most 14 days back). Nothing is sent if there are none. Returns the report's text when asked for a response.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Smartschool account.

since.name: Since
since.description: Report results published since this date, instead of since the last report.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Send to Telegram. Leave empty to follow the Telegram switch.

print.name: Print
print.description: Print the receipt. Leave empty to follow the Print receipt switch.

telegram_not_set_up.message: Telegram isn't set up: pick a Telegram chat in the integration's options.

printer_not_set_up.message: The receipt printer isn't set up: add its address in the integration's options.

nowhere_to_send.message: Nowhere to send the report: Telegram and printing are both off or not set up.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Smartschool Homework entry with id {entry_id}.

pick_entry.message: There's more than one Smartschool account: pick one with config_entry_id.

telegram_chat_gone.message: The Telegram chat chosen for reports is no longer set up in the Telegram bot integration: pick a chat again in this integration's options.
